title: Symbolic computation in cubic Jordan matrix algebras and in related structures
summary: We present CubicJordanMatrixAlg, a GAP package for symbolic computation in cubic Jordan matrix algebras and in related Lie-theoretic structures. As an application, we use it to compute certain (commutator) relations in $F_4$-graded groups that were constructed by De Medts and the author from cubic Jordan matrix algebras.
